dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Well, since you're asking... If you don't mind me being blunt, are you looking for ore?

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Someone mistook me for a researcher earlier and directed me toward a place full of Condessence Crystals. There's even Magical Crystal Ore to be had there.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: No one really comes around here, but I can't exactly leave, either... So if you need to, you can check it out. It's just nearby, after all.
